additional_info.subject: ID0451430-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP/R5 170001836] Multiple errors CRM:02889000672
additional_info.body:
Hi Chlöe, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
Ingo is no longer working with us and he had pass onto the region the ticket for support.
For the converter that is missing, it's on the DC1 group:
Unfortunately, I cannot specifiy which one is missing due to the algorithm, what you need to do, is confirm from the list below, which one is missing.
First thing you should check is the CAN communication cables (black and white) if they are properly attached to the connector and to the converter input:
If the problem is still persisting, please try swapping this converter with the neighbour one, example, swap position/cables of TB1 and TB2.
If the problem still persists, replace the converter.
The charger is out of warranty even when the ticket was opened, so please align with Bart if you want to order a new converter,
Let me know your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
